svg.title: Azure AD Bulk Operations — RunspacePool Architecture
svg.desc: Three-part workflow: Azure AD extraction, RunspacePool parallel processing, export and reconciliation
svg.text: 30,000+ users — UPN, DisplayName, Office, EmployeeId extracted
RunspacePool initialized — min: 1 thread / max: 100 threads
Monitor — wait until all IsCompleted = $true (poll every 30s)
count(Store-A) + count(Store-B) = total — halt on mismatch
